name: Bedrock Usage Analyzer
description: CLI tool to calculate token usage statistics (TPM, RPM, TPD, p50, p90) for Amazon Bedrock foundation models, with quota visualization and application inference profile aggregation across CloudWatch metrics

structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/: Main Python package containing all source code
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/core/: Core analysis logic - orchestrator, metrics fetching, output generation
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/aws/: AWS service integrations - Bedrock, CloudWatch, Service Quotas, STS
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/utils/: Utility functions - CSV, YAML, UI helpers, path resolution with platformdirs
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/sync/: Metadata sync/refresh code - regions, FM lists, quota mapping
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/templates/: Jinja2 HTML templates for report generation
structure.src/bedrock_usage_analyzer/metadata/: Bundled metadata files (regions, FM lists, prefix mapping) - read-only defaults
structure.bin/: Bash wrapper scripts that auto-setup venv and invoke Python modules
structure.results/: Output directory for generated JSON and HTML reports (gitignored)
structure.assets/: Screenshot images (image1.png, image2.png, image3.png) for README documentation
structure.dev/: Development files including app-index.json and temporary files
structure.tests/: Offline pytest suite with stubbed AWS clients (no AWS calls)
